messages.content: What is the best month to visit Hawaii?

function.name: get_average_monthly_temperature
function.description: Retrieve the average monthly temperature of a location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location that you want to get the average monthly temperature for.

month.description: Month for which the average temperature needs to be fetched.

message.content:
Hawaii’s climate is warm year‑round, so “the best” month depends largely on what you’re looking for:

| What matters | Best time |
|--------------|-----------|
| **Lowest crowd & price** | Late April–early June or late August–September – shoulder seasons when many tourists leave after summer school holidays. |
| **Best surf conditions** | Winter months (November–February) bring larger swells ideal for experienced surfers. |
| **Mildest temperatures & lowest humidity** | Mid‑April through early July—temperatures hover around 80 °F (27 °C), rain is minimal, and there’s plenty of sunshine. |
| **Great whale watching** | December–January along the Kona coast. |

If your priority is comfortable beach days without too much heat or crowds, **late spring (May–June)** or **early fall (September)** tend to offer the sweet spot: pleasant temperatures (~82 °F / 28 °C), lower rainfall, and more affordable accommodations compared to high‑summer peaks.
